description: This PHP class 'SideBar' extends AcceptanceTester and provides methods for interacting with sidebar UI components such as clicking specific sections like 'Action', 'Recently Viewed', and 'Favorites', as well as toggling the sidebar visibility.

classes.name: SideBar
classes.description: A helper class for acceptance tests that provides methods for interacting with sidebar UI elements.

methods.name: clickSideBarAction
methods.description: Clicks on a specified sidebar action link within the '#actionMenuSidebar' section.

methods.name: clickSideBarRecentlyViewed
methods.description: Clicks on a specified link within the 'Recently Viewed' sidebar section.

methods.name: clickSideBarFavorite
methods.description: Clicks on a specified link within the 'Favorites' sidebar section.

methods.name: clickToggleSideBar
methods.description: Toggles the visibility of the sidebar by clicking the toggle button.
